name: OVERTAKE
old_description: In 2019, Justin Grimm sold his previous company to a private equity firm. Very soon after, he realized that the original values of the company started to slip away. He also realized this was not only happening with his own company, it was unfortunately becoming a frequent thing in the aftermarket community. He saw the soul of the automotive scene slipping away. The smaller shops, the craftsmanship, the community-focused values — all were being overshadowed by corporate giants more interested in profits than passion. So, he took a step back, reimagined the future, and founded OVERTAKE to give enthusiasts, like you, the parts, service, and attention to detail that you deserve.
about:
OVERTAKE is based in St Paul, Minnesota, and was founded in 2019 by Justin Grimm after he sold his previous company to a private equity firm. Grimm observed that the original values of his former business—and of the broader automotive aftermarket—were eroding under corporate ownership, so he started OVERTAKE to restore community-focused craftsmanship for Subaru enthusiasts.

The company designs and manufactures a range of aftermarket performance parts for Subaru models including the WRX, STI, Forester XT, BRZ/86, Crosstrek, and others. Its product line covers transmission mount inserts, post-MAF pipe kits, top-mount intercoolers, DAVCS cam solenoid heat shields, and gasket sets. OVERTAKE emphasizes engineered products at accessible price points and involves its community in product development through a dedicated Facebook group.

OVERTAKE serves the automotive aftermarket, specifically Subaru performance enthusiasts and retail customers, and also supports a dealer network. The company offers a 10% hero discount to military personnel, teachers, and healthcare workers, and provides free shipping on most orders over $250 within the lower 48 states.

Grimm started OVERTAKE to rebuild what he saw as lost values—passion, quality, and community engagement. The company differentiates itself with same-day shipping on orders placed by 2 PM CST, a 30-day hassle-free return policy, and a crowd-sourced design process that aims to over-deliver on community feedback.
